companyHella.label: Forvia Hella
companyHella.description:
HELLA AUTOTECHNIK NOVA is part of FORVIA HELLA, an international automotive supplier focused on lighting technology and electronics.

Its Mohelnice site develops, manufactures and tests automotive headlights. Its work spans engineering, optics and electronics as well as plastic components and lighting module assembly.

The site also includes testing laboratories and a prototype workshop. Czech teams contribute to international automotive lighting projects.
values: Implementation and support of software for manufacturing MES system.
Development of progressive web-based applications to streamline headlight production.
Consultancy on MES system development and support.
Cooperation on international projects, communication in English language.

projectUnitExplorer.label: Unit Explorer
projectUnitExplorer.displayDescription: This is a progressive web application designed to display detailed information about a specific headlight. The application provides an overview of the testing process, measured values, individual components and other technical parameters. Although primarily optimized for mobile devices, it is also fully compatible with desktop platforms.
values: This is a progressive web application designed to display detailed information about a specific headlight. The application provides an overview of the testing process, measured values, individual components and other technical parameters. Although primarily optimized for mobile devices, it is also fully compatible with desktop platforms. The frontend is implemented using HTML, CSS and Vaadin, while the backend is in Java programming language.

projectProjectServer.label: Project Server
projectProjectServer.displayDescription: It is a progressive web application designed to run JNLP projects and monitor their progress on different devices in the company. The application replaces the outdated project server, which has been completely redesigned and enhanced with new features. The primary focus of the app is desktop use, however it is functional on mobile devices as well.

diplomaThesis.label: Diploma thesis
diplomaThesis.displayDescription: As part of my diploma thesis, I designed and implemented the web application KlikFit, which allows users to create, manage, and view individual training plans, track athletic progress, and communicate with each other. Training plans can be created manually or automatically based on user-defined parameters.
values: As part of my diploma thesis, I designed and implemented the web application KlikFit, which allows users to create, manage, and view individual training plans, track athletic progress, and communicate with each other. Training plans can be created manually or automatically based on user-defined parameters. The application is built on React, Next.js, MaterialUI, Tailwind, TypeScript, Node.js, and MySQL technologies.

bachelorThesis.label: Bachelor thesis
bachelorThesis.displayDescription: For my bachelor thesis, I created a gambling desktop game with RPG elements and a Star Wars theme, based on the concept of existing games (Pazaak, Gladiatus, Shakes and Fidget, ...) but with an original implementation. As part of my work, I not only implemented the game itself, but also analyzed the game technology and development methodology. The game implements a computer opponent algorithm that is able to analyze the situation and create a strategy during a card game.
values: For my bachelor thesis, I created a gambling desktop game with RPG elements and a Star Wars theme, based on the concept of existing games (Pazaak, Gladiatus, Shakes and Fidget, ...) but with an original implementation. As part of my work, I not only implemented the game itself, but also analyzed the game technology and development methodology. The game implements a computer opponent algorithm that is able to analyze the situation and create a strategy during a card game. The game logic is written in the Java programming language and I created the visual elements using the DALLE-E 2 model and the Photoshop graphics editor.

atreoDigital.label: Atreo Digital s.r.o.
atreoDigital.description:
Atreo Digital is an Ostrava-based company focused on developing websites and web applications.

It specialises in complex systems tailored to client needs and helps clients choose suitable technologies.

Its development process emphasises ongoing communication and transparency about project progress, timelines and budgets.
values: Development and maintenance of frontend and backend applications.
Code reviews, testing and deployment of changes.
Analysis and implementation of computational models.

projectMonery.label: Monery
projectMonery.displayDescription: A web application designed to aggregate, track, and analyze investment portfolios across multiple brokerages in a unified dashboard. The platform translates raw transaction data into actionable financial metrics, asset allocation breakdowns, and performance analytics.
values: Architected and implemented core computational models for investment analytics, portfolio returns, and multi-currency performance tracking.
Developed end-to-end full-stack features, ranging from interactive analytical dashboards and visualization charts to backend data processing pipelines.
Designed data normalization workflows to aggregate and harmonize transaction histories from diverse brokerage platforms.
Conducted code reviews, validated the precision of financial calculation engines via unit tests, and managed production deployments.
